cues: Meselson and Stahl settled it in nineteen fifty eight.
They grew E coli on heavy nitrogen fifteen, then moved it to ordinary nitrogen fourteen, and spun the DNA in a density gradient.
At the start: one heavy band.
After one generation: one band, of intermediate, hybrid density.
That alone kills the conservative model, which predicts a heavy and a light band.
